ExploitBench.description: Cap percent by selected metric across reasoning-effort levels on ExploitBench.

value.expr: {'Model': datum.model, 'Reasoning effort': upper(substring(datum.juice_level, 0, 1)) + substring(datum.juice_level, 1), 'Output Tokens': format(datum.x_value, ',.0f'), 'Cap percent': datum.score_label}

ExploitGym.description: Intended exploit rate versus simulated latency for ExploitGym runs.

value.expr: selectedMetric === 'api_cost_usd' ? {'Model': datum.model, 'Reasoning effort': upper(substring(datum.juice_level, 0, 1)) + substring(datum.juice_level, 1), 'Cost': '$' + format(datum.x_value, ',.2f'), 'Intended exploits': format(datum.score, '.2%')} : selectedMetric === 'output_tokens' ? {'Model': datum.model, 'Reasoning effort': upper(substring(datum.juice_level, 0, 1)) + substring(datum.juice_level, 1), 'Output tokens': format(datum.x_value, ',.0f'), 'Intended exploits': format(datum.score, '.2%')} : {'Model': datum.model, 'Reasoning effort': upper(substring(datum.juice_level, 0, 1)) + substring(datum.juice_level, 1), 'Simulated latency': format(datum.x_value, ',.1f') + ' min', 'Intended exploits': format(datum.score, '.2%')}

axis.labelExpr: selectedMetric === 'api_cost_usd' ? '$' + format(datum.value, ',.0f') : selectedMetric === 'output_tokens' ? (datum.value === 0 ? '0' : format(datum.value / 1000, ',.0f') + 'k') : datum.value === 0 ? '0 min' : format(datum.value, ',.0f') + ' min'
